picks.headline: Anthropic Releases Claude Sonnet 5 Approaching Opus-Level Agentic Performance
picks.why: It delivers near-Opus level coding, reasoning, and tool-use performance at significantly lower operational cost.
picks.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5

picks.headline: OpenAI Unveils Specialized GPT-5.6-Cyber Model for Threat Defense
picks.why: Introduces a dedicated frontier model optimized specifically for defensive cybersecurity workflows via Daybreak Red.
picks.title: Expanding Daybreak as the Cyber Defense Window Narrows

picks.headline: Meta Releases Muse Glimmer 30B Open Vision-Language Model
picks.why: Provides an Apache 2.0 open-weight 30B model with a 120K context window optimized for local agentic vision tasks.
picks.title: Introducing Muse Glimmer

picks.headline: Interchangeable Encrypted Reasoning Traces Expose Proprietary LLM API Outputs
picks.why: Session-interchangeable encrypted reasoning traces allow adversaries to decrypt hidden chain-of-thought outputs using cheaper models.
picks.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs

picks.headline: KVGov Prevents Timing Side-Channel Leakage in Shared KV Caches
picks.why: Mitigates cross-tenant prompt extraction vulnerabilities in shared LLM inference infrastructure using cryptographic salting.
picks.title: Governing the KV Cache: Preventing Timing Side-Channel Leakage in Multi-Tenant LLM Inference

picks.headline: Activation Probes Surface Code Security Vulnerabilities LLM Outputs Miss
picks.why: Demonstrates that open-weight model internal activations contain security signals that standard text and reasoning outputs fail to express.
picks.title: Activation Probes Surface Code-Security Signals that the Model's Output Misses

picks.headline: ExecuTorch Adds End-to-End Local Runtime Support for Muse Glimmer
picks.why: Enables low-latency execution of 30B agentic models directly on edge NVIDIA CUDA and Apple Silicon devices.
picks.title: Fast, On Device Agentic AI with Muse Glimmer on ExecuTorch

papers.headline: Matryoshka Training Stacks Nested Sub-Models for In-Flight Distillation
papers.why: Enables joint training of nested model architectures within a single parameter set for efficient speculative decoding and distillation.
papers.title: Matryoshka Language Model Suites

papers.headline: OasisKV Prefetches KV Cache Blocks Beyond HBM Using Speculative Lookahead
papers.why: Bypasses memory capacity limits in long-context generation by using speculative tokens to prefetch sparse KV blocks from host memory.
papers.title: OasisKV: Scaling In-Decode KV Cache Beyond HBM with Lookahead Sparse Prefetching

papers.headline: Steerling-8B Proves Interpretability Constraints Scale Without Performance Loss
papers.why: Shows that incorporating interpretability constraints directly into training scales to 8B parameters without sacrificing core language modeling capabilities.
papers.title: Scaling Inherently Interpretable Language Models
